Fab listings were researched as optional alternatives, but no Fab files were
silently downloaded because accepting a Fab listing requires the user's own
Epic account/library state. The current scene therefore has no hidden login,
subscription, paid-content, or attribution dependency.

The Main Home hero storefront uses Painted Plaster Wall and Green Metal Rust
as its account-free CC0 production fallback. Fab was checked first for the
free Quixel Construction Plaster and Rusty Metal Sheet listings; those remain
optional because acquiring them changes the user's Fab library state.
